what: These are the bytes v0.5.0 published, copied here so a reader can check the page against something that is not the page. v0.5.0 is the first release the signing key covers; v0.4.1 predates it and stays unsigned.

ots.detail: Bitcoin block 976735 (2026-11-20T14:17:33Z); the page keeps its 272-byte calendar proof because it is frozen, and the upgraded proof is in this directory (BITCOIN-ATTESTATION.json)

limits: A signature says which key signed these bytes, not who controls that key outside this repository. The Bitcoin block proves the digest existed by 2026-11-20 14:17:33Z; it does not prove who published it, and it does not prove the workflow behaved.
